name: Arcade Warlord
storyline:
Master a ruthless economy tethered to a live, volatile stock market.
Engineer the hits: Research, design, and manufacture the arcade cabinets of the future.
Conquer the streets: Seize territory and expand your empire across a living city grid.
Command your workforce: Hire Agents defined by Personality, attributes and skills.
Execute corporate sabotage: Syphoon Rival Arcade Machines revenue, Raid Rival Floor Spaces and execute special ops.
summary: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.
